meta.principle: This file holds INPUTS only. Every derived value (promo monthly, promo discount, amount due today, indicative contract value) is computed once by build_pricing.py and emitted to pricing.generated.json plus snippets/zv-pricing.liquid. No page, cart, configurator, confirmation or analytics event may compute or hardcode a price or duration independently.
meta.supersedes: pricing.config.json v2.0.0 (1.5x 'eerste vooruitbetaling' commitment model). The commitment prepayment is retired. Today's payment is the chosen installation option plus the first 3 months of the package itself, prepaid: the real package product is added to the cart at quantity promo.months (3) and Shopify's automatic 'Eerste 3 maanden' discount takes promo.ratePercent (50%) off that line. Both are collected by Shopify at checkout; the monthly rate is never modified and is billed by Odoo from month 4 (see unresolved ODOO_PROMO_DISCOUNT). This resolves the v2 ODOO_COMMITMENT_TREATMENT blocker.

rounding.note: Currency-safe. All money is integer cents. Never float. Banker's rounding is explicitly rejected: 1.5 x 2495 = 3742.5 must round to 3743, not 3742.

promo.enabledNote: This flag means 'the promo mechanism is a confirmed, computed part of the pricing model' — it's what makes build_pricing.py compute promoDiscountTotal/promoWas/dueToday at all, using the rate/months below. It is NOT an on/off switch for the storefront: since 2026-09-23 the only switch is the Shopify automatic discount 'Eerste 3 maanden' itself (Shopify admin, Discounts). The theme setting zv_promo_live that used to gate the actie page was removed the same day. If the discount is ever deactivated, the Overzicht page blocks checkout for any package line that arrives undiscounted (see zv-checkout-overview.liquid), so a customer can never pay 3 full months. Only set `enabled` to false here if the promo concept itself is retired for good.
promo.label: Korting eerste 3 maanden (50%)
promo.disclosure: De eerste 3 maanden betaalt u vooruit met 50% korting, eenmalig bij uw bestelling. Daarna betaalt u het vaste maandbedrag via SEPA-incasso. Alle bedragen zijn inclusief btw (21%).
promo.note: MODEL (2026-09-23, Thijs): a package purchase is the chosen installation product (qty 1, never discounted) plus the real package product at quantity `months` (3). Shopify's automatic discount 'Eerste 3 maanden' (amount off products, 50%, no end date, does not combine, scope exactly N0001/N0002/N0003/LT-BES/MT-PRO/MT-VIS — nothing to build, never modified from this repo) takes `ratePercent` off that line by itself. The Overzicht breakdown reads that line's real final_line_price. promoDiscountTotalCents is what those 3 prepaid months cost, rounded PER UNIT like Shopify: months x half_up(monthly x rate), e.g. 3 x 1248 = 3744 for Zeker, not half_up(3 x 2495 x 50%) = 3743 (decided by Thijs 2026-09-23 after measuring real carts; see docs/prepay-qty3-2026-09-23.md). indicativeContractValue uses the same figure: activation + promoDiscountTotal + monthly x (term - months). The monthly recurring price is never modified anywhere in this flow. SUPERSEDES the 2026-09-22 prepaid PROMO product model (separate per-package promo products), abandoned 2026-09-23: those products were deleted from Shopify because every new Shopify product becomes a stub product in Odoo. 'disclosure' above is the approved customer-facing wording (Thijs, 2026-09-23).
promo.discountScopeNote: 2026-10-23 (Thijs): Inzicht, Zeker and Alert now sell as A0071/A0072/A0073 (handles nami-langer-thuis-inzicht, nami-langer-thuis-zeker, nami-mijn-thuis-alert); the old N0001/N0002/N0003 products were archived and are internal-only. The 'Eerste 3 maanden' automatic discount is scoped to specific products in Shopify Admin, and its scope still names the archived products, so the intro discount does NOT apply to A0071-A0073 until Thijs re-points it at the new products in Admin (Discounts). Admin-side only: this repo never modifies the discount. The scope list in `note` above describes the pre-2026-10-23 state. UPDATE 2026-10-24 (Admin API, read-only): re-pointed. The scope is now A0071/A0072/A0073, LT-BES, MT-PRO, MT-VIS and N0008; no Koop product (K001-K005) is in it, and Overzicht blocks checkout for a Koop line that carries a discount anyway (cart_koop_bad). UPDATE 2026-10-28 (Thijs, Admin): H750 and H0010 (the Huren Videodeurbel and Afstandsbediening) were added to the scope, which is now 10 products; the Koop variants (ADC-750, CL004) and A102B are still outside it.
promo.labelCommitmentNote: labels.commitment is the breakdown-row suffix for the package line on Overzicht, rendered as '<pakket> × <months> — <labels.commitment>', e.g. 'Zeker × 3 — eerste 3 maanden (50% korting)'. Originally the retired v2 'Eerste vooruitbetaling' label.

koop.note: Huren/Kopen toggle (feature/huren-kopen-toggle-2026-10-23, draft). Kopen = buy the hardware: koopEenmalig once, then koopMaandelijks per month for the service only (no hardware cost in it), instead of the full monthlyRecurringPrice. Only the 5 fixed packages have it (never Vista, never Veilig Onderweg); among the add-ons only the hardware ones in addonNames carry koopEenmalig (Videodeurbel, Afstandsbediening), never a service such as Ontzorgpakket. promoApplies false: the intro promo (promo above, 50% off the first 3 months) is Huren only. build_pricing.py never runs a koop figure through the promo maths and check_pricing.py fails if a koop row carries a promo field; the theme never adds a koop variant at promo.packageCartQuantity. The Koop products exist since 2026-10-23 (K001-K005, koopProduct below each package; created in Shopify Admin, never from this repo). Each package and add-on gets its Koop variant id from a theme setting (Zo Veilig - Huren/Kopen); empty = the Kopen button / checkbox shows 'binnenkort' and adds nothing. See cartNote for how /cart, Overzicht and the cart guard treat a Koop line. Odoo (SEPA amount, contract template for a koop service fee) is out of scope and not done. See docs/koop-checkout-2026-10-24.md.
koop.cartNote: Cart/Overzicht (feature/koop-checkout-2026-10-23, 2026-10-24). A Koop package line is a line with the property Afname: Kopen (written by addKoopToCart() in sections/oplossingen.liquid) whose product handle is that package's koopProduct.handle (K001-K005, Shopify Admin, verified 2026-10-24); snippets/zv-koop-fk.liquid maps it to the package's finderKey. Only one of the two (the property without a known handle, or a known handle without the property) is malformed and blocks checkout. A Koop line is quantity 1 (zv-cart-guard resets it), is never counted as a huur package (no x3, no promo, no looptijd, no ICV, not in 'Daarna'), and must carry no discount: Overzicht blocks checkout if one reaches it. It takes the same installation step as huur by installGroup (NAMI: the customer's choice on Overzicht; Climax: CL003, added by addKoopToCart() and zv-cart-guard). Woning on a bought NAMI package is the Woning property only, no N0008 line, nothing charged for it today (Thijs, 2026-10-24); Odoo bills it with the monthly service fee. The service fee (koopMaandelijks) is never a Shopify cart line.

surcharges.name: Per extra etage
surcharges.description: Inzicht, Zeker en Alert (NAMI): +€4 p/m per extra etage.
surcharges.collectedVia: NAMI packages (appliesTo: Inzicht, Zeker, Alert; Thijs, 2026-09-25). Two records per choice. (1) The `Woning` line-item property on the NAMI package line, unchanged from 2026-09-24 (same values, same legacy prefix, same writers): the per-package record for Odoo. (2) ONE priced cart line for the Shopify product shopify.handle / shopify.sku (N0008, 'Extra etage of >100m2'), at quantity promo.months x the sum of floors over the NAMI package lines (1 floor = 3, 2 floors = 6, no Woning = no line). N0008 is in the 'Eerste 3 maanden' automatic discount (set in Shopify Admin, never from this repo), so each floor costs promo.months x half_up(price.amountCents x promo.ratePercent) today (600 cents at 400 / 50%); Odoo bills price.amountCents per floor per month from month 4. Since 2026-10-27 the Climax packages (Beschermd, Protect) have the same mechanism with their own product: surcharges[extra-etage-climax] (E001). Every surcharge entry with a `shopify` product is one Woning product for the packages of its installGroup; a package's Woning line is the entry whose appliesTo lists it, never another platform's. Supersedes 'property only, never a priced line' (2026-09-24).

woning.heading: Woning groter dan 100 m² en/of meer dan 1 verdieping?
woning.note: Woning surcharge (docs/pakket-wijzigingen-2026-09-23.md §7; decisions by Thijs 2026-09-24 and 2026-09-25, see docs/woning-surcharge-research-2026-09-23.md and docs/woning-n0008-line-2026-09-25.md; Climax since 2026-10-27, docs/a102b-e001-climax-woning-2026-10-27.md). This is THE Woning choice for every platform: surcharges[extra-etage-climax] has no woning block of its own and uses this one, so the heading, the option values Odoo recognises and the legacy prefix can never differ between NAMI and Climax. The choice is written as the `Woning` line-item property on the package line, exactly as since 2026-09-24 (the per-package record for Odoo), AND collected as one priced cart line per Woning product (N0008 for NAMI, E001 for Climax; see collectedVia above), so Shopify charges its first 3 months today with the promo discount and Odoo bills it from month 4. options[].value is written verbatim as that property value (no price in it) and is what Odoo must recognise. Option N costs N x price.amountCents per month from month 4 and adds N x (promo.months x half_up(price.amountCents x promo.ratePercent) + price.amountCents x (termMonths - promo.months)) to the indicative contract value; build_pricing.py derives both. A stored value that starts with legacyValuePrefix (written before 2026-09-24) reads as 1 floor. heading is the question above the options on the package cards, in the Oplossingen cart drawer and in the Meer informatie modal.

surcharges.name: Per extra etage (Climax)
surcharges.description: Beschermd en Protect (Climax): +€4 p/m per extra etage.
surcharges.collectedVia: Climax packages (appliesTo: Beschermd, Protect; 2026-10-27). Mirrors surcharges[extra-etage] exactly, with its own Shopify product: the `Woning` property on the Climax package line (same values, from extra-etage.woning) plus ONE priced cart line for shopify.handle / shopify.sku (E001, 'Extra etage of >100m2 Climax'; Admin API 2026-10-27: ACTIVE, EUR 4,00, published to the Online Store, type NAMI_abonnementen) at quantity promo.months x the sum of floors over the Climax package lines. It is meant to be in the 'Eerste 3 maanden' discount like N0008, so each floor costs 600 cents today and Odoo bills price.amountCents per floor per month from month 4. On 2026-10-27 E001 is NOT in that discount yet: Overzicht blocks every Climax Woning checkout (cart_woning_bad) until it is added in Shopify Admin. Replaces the hardware page's removed #grotere-woning block (PR #152) as how a bigger Climax home is handled. price.amountCents must equal extra-etage's (build_pricing.py refuses otherwise): the cards, drawer and modal show one price per Woning option.

addonNames.name: Camera-abonnement videodeurbel
addonNames.note: Camera subscription for a bought Videodeurbel (2026-10-27): A102B, 'Camera abonnement Videodeurbel 1200 clips', EUR 3,50/mnd (Admin API 2026-10-27: ACTIVE, published to the Online Store, type 'ADC Camera ABO', not in the 'Eerste 3 maanden' discount). It is never a checkbox of its own: one A102B line rides along whenever the cart holds a line of ridesWith (ADC-750, the Videodeurbel's Koop product), and goes when that line goes. Resolved by handle in the theme, never a hardcoded variant id; its price is read live from the product, never config data. DECISION (reversed 2026-10-28): it syncs at PKG_QTY (promo.months, 3) like Ontzorgpakket, at full price, never discounted. Until 2026-10-28 it synced FLAT at quantity 1 (not the N0008 treatment), for three reasons: (1) the intro promo is Huren only (koop.promoApplies is false) and A102B is only ever triggered by a Koop purchase; (2) A102B is not in the 'Eerste 3 maanden' discount, so quantity promo.months would charge 3 full months today; (3) a recurring monthly service, billed by Odoo. The reversal keeps reasons 1 and 2 (A102B stays Koop-only and OUTSIDE 'Eerste 3 maanden': it prepays 3 months at FULL price, no discount badge, exactly like Ontzorgpakket) and adopts reason 3 as Ontzorgpakket's own rationale: a recurring monthly service prepays the months like a package line. zv-cart-guard rule 7 and Overzicht's rider gate use the same quantity. cartQuantity: 1 in this object is now a STALE reference value (build_pricing.py and check_pricing.py still pin it to 1 and it is emitted into addonRiders); nothing in the theme reads it, the theme syncs at PKG_QTY. Do not read it as 'flat'. It shares the open Odoo-billing question with Ontzorgpakket, H750 and H0010: how/when Odoo starts billing it from month 4 onward, not in Overzicht's 'Daarna' (unresolved.ODOO_ADDON_BILLING).

momentA.rule: The purchase value MUST equal the amount Shopify actually collects today: the chosen installation option plus the package line (quantity 3, after the automatic 50% 'Eerste 3 maanden' discount), i.e. the live cart total. Installation is never discounted. The ongoing monthly rate from month 4 is billed by Odoo, never collected by Shopify, and must never be added to this value.

momentB.rule: Uploaded from Odoo at pipeline stage Contract Signed. Blocked until Odoo confirms ODOO_PROMO_DISCOUNT (one contract at the plain monthly rate, SEPA from month 4).

labels.indicativeContractValue: Indicatieve totale contractwaarde, inclusief eenmalige kosten

forbidden.Pakketactivatie (1,5× maandbedrag): Mislabels the commitment as activation. Use labels.commitment.
forbidden.Totaal over looptijd: Hides that one-off charges are included. Use labels.indicativeContractValue.
forbidden.Ontzorgpakket × 3 — eerste 3 maanden (50: Ontzorgpakket Inzicht is not in the promo discount (2026-10-13, deliberate) — using labels.commitment here would falsely claim 50% off. Use labels.commitmentNoDiscount instead.

unresolved.summary: DOCUMENTATION ONLY (Thijs, 2026-09-23: Odoo is out of scope for this repo and this blocks nothing here; Thijs handles it with Alex). A package is sold as ONE Shopify order line: the package product at quantity 3 (e.g. A0072 x 3), 50% off, which prepays months 1-3. Odoo must turn that line into (1) exactly ONE contract at the plain monthly rate (e.g. €24,95/mnd) — not a contract at quantity 3 (€74,85/mnd) and not three contracts — and (2) start SEPA collection at month 4, not month 1, so months 1-3 are not charged twice. Neither is confirmed yet.
Alert, Protect and Vista were mapped onto the NAMI Alarm15, Climax and Alarm.com platforms by matching price level, since the workbook supplied names and prices only. Confirm the mapping is correct.
Veilig Onderweg remains unpriced and not purchasable.

installationOptions.nami option prices: Geen installatie (€0,00) and Telefonische ondersteuning (€35,00) remain Thijs's working default as of 2026-09-21, not confirmed by Odoo — expect adjustment before commercial launch. Installatie aan huis (€99,00) is no longer provisional in that sense: Thijs repriced the Shopify product directly and confirmed it correct on 2026-09-22 — still not necessarily Odoo-confirmed, but no longer a placeholder guess.

The monthly add-on products that prepay PKG_QTY months like a package line (Ontzorgpakket, the Huren rentals H750 and H0010 since 2026-10-28, and the A102B camera subscription that rides with a bought Videodeurbel since 2026-10-28; H750/H0010 at the discounted rate, Ontzorgpakket and A102B at full price) all share one open question: how and when Odoo starts billing them from month 4 onward (one contract at the plain monthly rate, SEPA from month 4, same as ODOO_PROMO_DISCOUNT for packages).
